_note: The four hero slides, taken apart. The founder supplied them on 13 September as four finished 1774×887 compositions — logo, eyebrow, two-tone headline, paragraph, call to action, three trust marks, two floating cards, a slide counter and a disclosure, all baked into pixels — and asked for the pieces loose so the app could draw them itself. This file is the words and the structure; packages/banners/ holds the one thing that has to stay a picture.
_whyNotJustShipThePictures: Because a picture of a headline is a headline nobody can translate, nobody can tab to, and no screen reader can read. Eleven locales carry this product's interface and a baked banner is English at every one of them. The call to action in each of these images is a button; as a JPEG it is a rectangle that does nothing. Every word below renders as text, every card is a real element, and the photograph is the only thing left that is genuinely a photograph.
_aboutThePhotographs: Cropped to the part of each composition the floating cards never covered, which is why they are portraits rather than the full landscape frame. The cards in the supplied art sit over the right-hand third of the photograph, and removing them convincingly is not something that can be done by stretching neighbouring pixels — it was tried and it looked exactly like what it was. The honest crop keeps every face and loses the corner. If the original photographs turn up without the cards on them, these crops widen and nothing else in this file changes.

slides.body: Nurse-led care at home, with doctor review and your health record in one place.

slides.eyebrow: Care for the people you love
slides.body: Arrange care for a loved one and stay connected, with their permission.
Move a little more. Eat well. Rest better. Healthy living, alongside your MyThuso care.
slides._wellbeingNote: This slide advertises Live well, so it is held to Live well's contract. packages/catalog/wellbeing.json forbids a score, a grade, a target, a streak, a rank, a percentage or a unit anywhere in that feature, and a slide that sells it may not promise what the screen behind it refuses. 'Move a little more', 'at your own pace' and 'nourish your everyday' all pass: none of them is a quantity, a goal or an instruction about food. 'Eat well' is the closest to the line and stays because it is the habit's own name in the contract, not advice about what to eat.

slides.body: Bring your nursing skills closer to home, with connected tools and doctor support.

standing.placeWhy: Top right of every slide in the supplied art, beside the eyebrow. It says where. It said "Johannesburg · Launch preview" until 28 September 2026, when the founder took the word preview off the hero as final copy: the notice bar above the hero and the footer still say, in their own sentences, that MyThuso is in development and that nothing on the page books a visit, and neither of those moved.
standing.photographNoteWhy: Beside the figure on every slide. The people shown are illustrative: none of them is a MyThuso nurse and none is a patient, which is the refusal the footer makes at length, and it stays at the picture rather than only in a footnote, because that is where somebody looks. It read "Design preview · Illustrative photography" until 28 September 2026; the founder took the word preview off the hero as final copy, and the refusal itself stays.
standing.priceLine: A SANC-registered nurse at your door, from {price}. A registered doctor reviews what they find.
standing.priceLineWhy: Under the headline on every slide, and never rotated away. Four reviews of the public page on 26 September agreed on one thing: a stranger could read the whole first screen and not learn what this costs or who comes. {price} is a placeholder the page fills from packages/catalog/services.json — the lowest launch price — so the sentence lives here and the number lives where every other number does.

stage._note: Added 28 September 2026 with the Lovable identity (packages/brand/lovable-handoff), whose hero is a stage: two slanted planes, a slant-cut portrait, a badge and a slow pulse. The figure is still the first slide's, above; what is new is the words the stage and the page around it carry, kept here beside the banner's so none of them is typed into features/Landing.tsx. Nothing below is a price, a share, a range or a refusal — those stay in their own contracts and the page reads them there.
stage.badge: GilbertOne, a guide on this page
stage.badgeWhy: The pulse beside it says that something on this page will answer, and something does: the public guide in the corner of the screen. It never says listening. The guide takes typed questions only, and a pulse beside the word listening on a page with no microphone would be a microphone indicator that lies.

guide.title: Ask GilbertOne
guide.line: GilbertOne is MyThuso’s guide. On this page it answers questions about the service, and the round button in the corner of the screen opens it.

kit.title: What a nurse would carry
kit.devicesWhy: Two of the instruments in the connected kit a nurse brings, as the handoff photographed them. The sentence under them is the devices capability's own notice from packages/catalog/capabilities.json, read by the page, because the numbers on these screens are a photographer's and no instrument is paired.

impact.title: One city first.
impact.coverage: Phase one is northern Johannesburg and Soweto. Everywhere else on this map is drawn because it is there, not because anybody is working in it.
impact.coverageWhy: A copy of packages/catalog/geography.json's coverage.sentence, word for word, and scripts/check-boundaries.mjs fails the build the moment the two differ. It is copied rather than imported because importing the geography contract into the public page hoisted all of it — every zone, window and refusal — into a chunk both entries load, 3.8 kB gzipped for one sentence.
impact.planNote: Where the funding proposal plans to open, in its order. A plan, not a promise.
impact.mapNote: An illustration of the country. The lines are not routes and the points are not clinics.
impact.why: The map is the handoff's network illustration of South Africa. Under it the page reads packages/catalog/geography.json's own coverage sentence, which says exactly how little of that map is served, and the points of packages/catalog/business-model.json's trajectory by name only: no visit count, subscriber figure or revenue from it is shown.

_iconNote: Names rather than glyphs. Each app already has an icon set and a way of drawing a tinted disc; naming the idea lets three platforms each draw it their own way, and stops a fourth copy of an SVG appearing in a JSON file.
_tintNote: Two tints, peach and mint, alternating between a slide's two cards. They are the brand's own, and the contrast pairs are declared in packages/design-tokens/tokens.json — the tint is a disc behind an icon and never carries a word.
_orderNote: Four slides in the order the founder numbered them, 01 to 04: what the service is, who it is for, what it adds, and who delivers it. The counter and the progress rule in the supplied art are the carousel's, and the app already draws both.
